  • Conhecimento básico de IAM (roles e policies).
  • Domínio de workflow avançado com Git/GitHub .
  • Experiência com Docker para containerização.
  • Conhecimento básico de CI/CD (GitHub Actions ou GitLab CI).


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Capital Agents
description:
We’re Expanding Our Global Capital Agent Network – Join Magnum Equities as an Independent Capital Agent


Remote | Global | Commission-Based | #PrivateEquity #CapitalRaising #InvestmentOpportunities #CapitalAgent #Agent #Broker #InvestmentBanker #PrivateMarkets #VentureCapital #Entrepreneurship


Are you a capital introducer, private banker, independent dealmaker, ultra-networker, or connected investment professional looking to monetize your network?


Magnum is seeking experienced Capital Agents to join our global sourcing network. These independent agents will facilitate capital to Magnum Equities and earn 2% commission on successfully funded partnership capital placements, from fiat currency to crypto currency.


Capital Agent – Independent Investment Sourcing Partner


Location: Global | Remote

Full | Part-time or Side gig with your current job


Industry: You can be of any industry sector background, early/mid/or late in your career, having a capital network of partnership investment prospects that desire high ROI via profit share in Magnum’s global real estate and business equities assets growth forward, and large-scale social impact.


Commission: 2% of Capital Raised


About Magnum Equities


Magnum is foremost a mass capital investment partnership platform, capital raise platform for SME's, and mass social impact/empowerment powerhouse. Magnum's main pillars: Real Estate Assets Partners | Tech/Business Equity Partners | Precious Metals | Sukuk (Marabaha) enabling Shariah compliant capital placement investment from micro to macro capital partners, via “Magnum Equities Partnership Tokenization". Enabling globally democratized - low barrier to entry (min 50 Euros/token) - investment, empowering individuals to large institutional capital placement participation in Magnum’s global portfolio rather than being limited to only a specific single asset, optimizing short/medium/long term (3-5yrs), ROI (3X/5X/10X/100X/2500X+), and abatement of any singular asset downside. Magnum also empowers Capital Agents with lucrative revenue streams for their facilitated capital. These can be individuals, SF/MF Private offices, fund managers, capital management firms, institutional etc. Fiat currency, & crypto currency investment enabled.


Our global investors are significantly advantaged leveraging their purchase of Magnum’s RWA tokens as profit share rights in Magnum's aggregate global performance forward. Micro to Macro partnerships via fractional partnership profit share tokenization on blockchain via our RWA/PropTech blockchain/fintech partner portal.


Magnum’s innovative fractional partnership structure provides flexibility to vest capital across GCC/MENA/North America Strategic Growth region assets without requiring local RWA tokenization adoption. Magnum enables periodic ROI distributions based on portfolio-wide performance metrics via smart contracts.


Magnum’s cutting edge RWA tokenized profit share partnership model maintains investors’ blockchain-enabled transparency.


Magnum provides its profit share partners/investors with what entities such as Berkshire Hathaway have provided capital investors, except much more opportunity, scope, innovation integration, social impact, & mass low barrier of entry to participate - individually to institutionally.

With Magnum, whether your vested fractional profit share tokens are aligned with our entire Real Estate focused portfolio, or as accredited investor choosing from our globally located Cross-industry sector companies seeking to raise capital, or both, you’re not stuck with just one asset, gated entry points, or vague returns. It’s about real productive assets you can see, touch, and feel, as well as large-scale pan-global business equity positions. Partners get fractional profit share access to a massive diverse portfolio, smart contract-driven payouts, and a model built for transparency and real growth.


Magnum is foremost a global partnership investment platform that lets you own fractional profit share rights in real-world assets (Large Scale Real Estate and Cross-Industry Business Equity)—tokenized for transparency, diversification, and ease of access. Think of it as owning a piece of a global portfolio, without needing millions to get started. Magnum is also engineered to be a democratizing, equal opportunity, income/earnings empowerment platform for often displaced masses of global micro investors to institutional, that want to be associated with a mass legacy-driven, cutting edge investment and social impact platform that empowers and restores micro-investor hope, dignity, respect, income equality, standard of living, growth, and vision within an investment climate that has historically displaced the masses. Magnum levels the playing field, ensuring equal opportunity and low barrier to entry. Is it a global movement? We think so.


Who does Magnum serve


Our model supports everyone—from Micro partners/investors (global individuals) to UHNW, Single/Multi-Family Offices, Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Endowments | Foundation/Charitable | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Infrastructure Funds etc. while empowering all our capital agents.


Role Overview


As a Capital Agent, you will:


  • Introduce and complete partner funding qualified capital partners/investors to the Magnum platform
  • Facilitate warm introductions and/or participate in closing efforts
  • Earn 2% on capital you raise – Simple!
  • Operate independently and flexibly, without exclusive commitment


What We Offer


  • Attractive transparent commission model - Unique Agent link to use | Earnings wallet
  • Leverage Magnum’s professionally curated pitch decks, site resources etc
  • Flexible, remote-first role – ideal for global professionals
  • Dedicated support: Capital partner relationship team and due diligence assistance
  • No licensing required (you are not soliciting or selling securities directly), only introductions to partnership
  • Global flexibility: Operate remotely, with no territory or geographic limits


Who This Is For


  • Individuals, capital introducers, private bankers, fund managers, capital firms, representative/legal firms, brokers, salespeople, investment professionals, endowments, charitable orgs with access to capital and capital networks
  • Individuals with relationships across single/multifamily offices, UHNWIs, boutique funds, or estate channels
  • Professionals looking to monetize their network without the burden of licensing or fund management


*Charitable organizations can utilize their Capital Agent role to drive mass charitable, and social impact for their various current and future programs.


This mass individual empowerment and expansive social impact integration is a purposeful and very important component to us at Magnum, in keeping with our 125yr tradition, where democratized opportunity for all, at every socio-economic level, every geo-location in developed and under-developed nations, can raise the ‘economic base of the societal pyramid’ in every region. Where capitalism can co-exist without displacement, with equality, dignity, respect, levelling the contentious playing field between the “have’s and the have not’s”.


Commission Example (2% on capital intake from each partner capital placement with Magnum)

Easy Next Step


Interested in joining the Magnum Equities Capital agent network?


Register as Capital Agent directly on Magnum's website:


Important Notes & Disclaimers


  • Magnum Equities does not require Capital Agents to hold securities licenses, as you are not directly soliciting or selling investment products. Only presenting partnership opportunity.
  • All commissions are distributed upon adequate clearing period.
  • All final post-placement due diligence, AML etc are handled internally by Magnum management.

  • Magnum Equities reserves the right to approve or reject capital partners at its sole discretion based on internal compliance protocols.

title: Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience will be responsible for building and maintaining cloud infrastructure and applications that primarily interface with data platforms, as well as building and maintaining Python-based applications that may or may not be deployed in the cloud. This role will ensure that our cloud environments and data-centric applications are built, configured, optimized, and adopted to meet evolving needs. The Cloud Engineer will own infrastructure requirements, configuration standards, performance optimization, and cross-team coordination related to cloud and data platforms.


Duties and Responsibilities:

Cloud Infrastructure and Data Platforms

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and secure cloud infrastructure that supports data platforms.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data platforms such as BigQuery/Redshift, GCS/S3, etc.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions using tools like Terraform/CloudFormation.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based CI/CD workflows for infrastructure and data platform deployments.
  • Monitor and optimize cloud resource performance and cost.
  • Ensure data quality checks for source, integration, and reporting layers; escalate defects with clear reproduction steps and impact.


Python Application Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain Python-based applications, both cloud-deployed and on-premises.
  • Utilize Python libraries such as Flask for application development.
  • Implement and manage CI/CD workflows for Python applications.
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate applications with cloud and data platforms.


Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.
  • Promote adoption of new data capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.


Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms, e.g., BigQuery/Redshift, GCS/S3, and etc.
  • Infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform/CloudFormation.
  • Cloud-based CI/CD workflows.
  • Performance and cost optimization for cloud resources.
  • Experience with Python and familiarity with libraries such as Flask.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Cloud-based IAM, networking, and security.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in cloud engineering, data engineering, systems administration, or product operations within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

About AnswerThis


AnswerThis is an AI-powered research platform built to eliminate the most time-consuming part of academic research: the literature review. We serve researchers globally, from PhD students to academic professionals, helping them go from query to a comprehensive, cited review in minutes.

Our system understands how papers connect, ranks relevance, summarizes insights, and maps citations. This removes weeks of manual work. But that is just the beginning. We are building a vertically integrated AI research suite that streamlines every stage of academic discovery.

If you want to design algorithms that directly accelerate science in medicine, AI, climate, and more, this is the place to do it.


The Role


We are hiring an AI Engineer to lead the development of the core intelligence behind AnswerThis. This role requires deep expertise in information retrieval, scalable backend systems, and generative AI.

You will:

  • Build and optimize semantic search pipelines, graph-based retrieval, and agentic systems.
  • Design and deploy scalable APIs and services capable of serving hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Architect, implement, and productionize vector databases and embedding-based retrieval systems.
  • Work on GenAI integrations including react agents, graph agents, prompt engineering, and LLM orchestration.
  • Set up full-stack search engines from scratch that can handle real-world academic workloads.
  • Contribute directly to the infrastructure that makes cutting-edge science more efficient.


This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will move fast, experiment, and ship production systems that impact thousands of researchers worldwide.


Requirements


  • Strong background in semantic search, vector databases, LLM frameworks, agent-based systems, and document retrieval.
  • Skilled in Python for backend development with the ability to build scalable APIs and services.
  • Past experience deploying systems at scale, including search engines, retrieval pipelines, or embedding models.
  • Ability to design infrastructure that serves hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Experience setting up and hosting APIs with public access while balancing speed, cost, and reliability.
  • A research-driven and pragmatic mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes.


Compensation


$20,000 – 40,000 / year depending on experience, expertise, and scope of ownership. This is a full-time role with significant responsibility and long-term upside.


How to Apply


Send the following to

Subject: AI Engineer Application

Include:

  • Your resume.
  • Details of past projects, especially production-level work with search, retrieval, or GenAI pipelines.
  • A short note on why you want to design algorithms at AnswerThis.


Applications without these will not be considered.

Let us build the future of research together.

You'll have the opportunity to conduct and participate in experiments, make suggestions to improve our architecture and product and use tons of data to make the best decisions.

title: Sustaining Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.


*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

title: Architect
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an Architecture Lead to drive the design and execution of brand experiences, pop-ups, permanent retail spaces, and large-scale installations. This role merges creative vision with technical expertise, bridging design, production, and fabrication to deliver exceptional innovative environments. You'll lead projects from concept through construction, providing strategic direction, coordinating cross-disciplinary teams, and serving as the key liaison between creative leadership, production, and fabrication partners.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead multiple projects simultaneously
  • Drive design development from initial concept through detailed construction documentation
  • Establish and maintain design standards, ensuring high-quality, innovative, and functional outcomes
  • Collaborate with producers and project managers to maintain project timelines, milestones, and deliverables
  • Partner with creative directors to understand design intent and translate it into clear architectural strategies
  • Generate daily creative briefs to guide the architecture design team on project direction and next steps
  • Provide real-time feedback, guidance, and mentorship to junior architectural designers throughout the design process
  • Communicate and present complex design ideas clearly to both creative and technical stakeholders
  • Develop precise schematic drawing packages and 3D models in Rhinoceros for vendor and fabricator coordination
  • Ensure all drawings and designs comply with relevant codes, standards, and regulations for domestic and international markets
  • Collaborate directly with engineers, fabricators, and contractors to identify optimal solutions for project execution
  • Review and approve shop drawings and fabrication details prior to production
  • Research, review, and specify appropriate materials and finishes
  • Provide construction oversight to ensure design intent is maintained throughout on-site execution


REQUIREMENTS

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Architecture
  • 8+ years of professional experience in architecture, with proven leadership in design-driven projects
  • Experience with retail, set design, exhibitions, or experiential installations
  • Strong understanding of materials, construction methods, and fabrication processes
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in creating technical drawings and specifications
  • Excellent leadership, organizational, and communication skills
  • Portfolio demonstrating design excellence and ability to work on projects at different scales
  • Ability to manage fast-paced projects and adapt quickly to shifting priorities
  • Ability to work effectively independently and as part of a team
  • Professional knowledge and use of Rhinoceros is mandatory
  • Proficient in Google Docs suite (Docs, Slides, Spreadsheet)
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign)
  • Ability to quickly learn Cinema 4D and Octane rendering software



ABOUT DE-YAN

DE-YAN is a brand experience studio built to lead the next era of human connection.

We seamlessly fuse creative development, in-house production, and immersive storytelling to create authentic, human-first moments – moments that are proven to build a powerful relationship between brands and their audiences.


With deep roots in fashion, luxury, beauty, and lifestyle, DE-YAN balances concept and craft to create innovative, experience-led creative across five key disciplines: Experiential Design, Motion, Creative Technology, Graphic Design, and Physical Production - all rooted in Creative Strategy and a deep understanding of culture. Our global team of 120+ full-time creatives spans New York, Los Angeles, EU, Brazil, and Canada, allowing us to bring diverse perspectives and rigorous precision to every brief.

description:
NOSSAS PESSOAS, JUNTAS, LIDERAM COM CONSCIÊNCIA.

Responsabilidades:

  • Ser responsável técnico pelas metodologias de provisionamento de perda esperada (ECL) da carteira de crédito, assegurando consistência entre o modelo, as bases de dados e as regras contábeis.

  • Conduzir análises retroativas e de performance dos modelos (backtesting, estabilidade de variáveis, KS, AUC, PSI, curing rate, hazard e survival curves) para identificar desvios e propor evoluções metodológicas.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com as áreas de Crédito, Cobrança, Contabilidade, Financeiro e Risco, traduzindo necessidades do negócio em soluções analíticas robustas e sustentáveis.

O que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência em modelagem de risco de crédito regulatória (PD, LGD, EAD e Estágios IFRS9).
  • Domínio técnico das normas IFRS9 e regulamentos BACEN (4966, 229, 2682).
  • Proficiência em Python (pandas, pyspark, scikit-learn) e SQL, com foco em manipulação e modelagem de grandes bases de dados.
  • Vivência com Databricks e Spark, preferencialmente em ambientes de produção (Delta Tables, workflows automatizados).
  • Sólida experiência em avaliação de performance de modelos (KS, AUC, PSI, estabilidade).

Desejável

  • Conhecimento prático de provisão contábil, roll rates, vintage analysis e estrutura de matrizes de transição.
  • Noções de LGD baseada em recuperação e fluxos de castigo (cash flow de perda).


O que você vai encontrar por aqui?

Somos mais do que um lugar de trabalho: construímos e vivemos diariamente o Ecossistema Bem Estar Bem, baseado na relação harmoniosa entre cada indivíduo, as relações ao seu redor e o ambiente em que está inserido. About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)

  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

Job Description:

We are seeking highly analytical and detail-oriented professionals with hands-on experience in Red Teaming, Prompt Evaluation , and AI/LLM Quality Assurance . The ideal candidate will help us rigorously test and evaluate AI-generated content to identify vulnerabilities, assess risks, and ensure compliance with safety, ethical, and quality standards.

  • Collaborate with data scientists, safety researchers, and prompt engineers to report risks and suggest mitigations.
  • Perform manual QA and content validation across model versions, ensuring factual consistency, coherence, and guideline adherence.
  • Create evaluation frameworks and scoring rubrics for prompt performance and safety compliance.

  • Understanding of LLM behaviors, failure modes, and model evaluation metrics.
  • Excellent critical thinking, pattern recognition, and analytical writing skills.
  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed evaluation protocols, and meet tight deadlines.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Fornecer suporte funcional e resolver incidentes durante e após a migração.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e ministrar treinamentos para usuários-chave.
  • Seguir metodologias SAP (ASAP, Activate, Agile) durante a execução dos projetos.


Qualificações


  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência como Consultor SAP PLM.
  • Experiência prática em projetos de migração ECC → S/4HANA.
  • Sólido conhecimento em DMS, ECM e integrações de processos PLM.
  • Entendimento de gestão de dados mestres e seu papel no PLM.
  • Experiência com ciclos de teste (UT, IT, UAT).
  • Inglês avançado ou superior.
  • Espanhol intermediário ou superior.
  • Conhecimento de aplicativos Fiori para PLM no S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de migração de dados (LTMC, LSMW, SAP Migration Cockpit).
  • Familiaridade com SAP Solution Manager para documentação e testes.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.
  • Capacidade de atuar em equipes internacionais e multifuncionais.


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?


  • Desenvolva sua Carreira: Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes: Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo: Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo(a) a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente: Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores


  • Cultura de Inovação: Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade: Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.


Como se Candidatar


Os(as) candidatos(as) interessados(as) podem se inscrever enviando seu currículo e carta de apresentação para ou através de deste anúncio.


A Motivus é um empregador que promove a igualdade de oportunidades e incentiva a diversidade e inclusão no local de trabalho.

We are seeking detail-oriented and dedicated professionals with hands-on experience in audio transcription and quality assurance . The ideal candidate will be responsible for accurately converting audio content into written text, maintaining high standards of accuracy, consistency, and confidentiality throughout the process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Listen carefully to audio recordings and transcribe them into clear, accurate, and grammatically correct text .
  • Identify and correct transcription errors , ensuring proper spelling, punctuation, and formatting.
  • Handle different accents, speech clarity levels, and background noises with attention to detail.
  • Tag and label transcriptions as per project guidelines.
  • Review, proofread, and edit transcripts for quality, accuracy, and completeness .
  • Follow client-specific formatting and delivery instructions.
  • Work closely with project leads and QA teams to meet daily quality and productivity targets .
  • Maintain confidentiality and data security of all content handled.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in audio transcription or related linguistic work.
  • Excellent command of English (or other project-specific language) with strong grammar and listening skills.
  • Good typing speed and accuracy with familiarity in transcription tools or software.
  • Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines .
  • High attention to detail and ability to follow formatting guidelines strictly.
  • Must have a reliable internet connection, functional laptop/desktop, and good-quality headphones (mandatory).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in AI training, transcription QA, or linguistic data projects .
  • Familiarity with timestamping, labeling, or annotation tasks .
  • Experience working with global transcription platforms or large-scale linguistic projects.
  • Knowledge of speech-to-text software and audio editing tools is an added advantage.

title: Franchise Business Consultant - LATAM
description:
The Franchise Business Consultant – LATAM supports Master Franchise and Direct Franchise partners across Latin America by providing operational guidance, financial coaching, and training to drive performance while ensuring alignment with Gold’s Gym global standards. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English and proficiency in Spanish to effectively collaborate across diverse markets in the region. The FBC conducts regular market visits, virtual consultations, and leads both in-person and online training sessions. This is a remote role based out of the Brasil. Frequent travel throughout Latin America—up to 50% or more—is required.


Responsibilities:


Franchise Support & Coaching

  • Serve as the primary operational liaison for Master Franchise and Direct Franchise owners, offering consultative support on day-to-day operations, financial performance, leadership development, and member experience.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across culturally and linguistically diverse markets, ensuring business strategies align with Gold’s Gym standards while adapting to local market needs.
  • Conduct regular check-ins and annual in-person site visits with each franchise location in the assigned LATAM territory.
  • Provide guidance and resources to drive operational excellence and regional growth.
  • Leverage KPI benchmarks, and digital platforms to monitor and support franchise performance.


Training & Leadership Development

  • Develop and deliver in-person and virtual training sessions in Portuguese (and Spanish where applicable) for franchisees and their teams, focusing on operational efficiency, member experience, and profitability.
  • Facilitate webinars, learning sessions, and peer collaboration forums to promote continuous learning and knowledge sharing in the LATAM market.
  • Lead onboarding programs for new franchisees and gym leaders, providing a strong foundation in Gold’s Gym systems, standards, and growth strategies.
  • Champion the rollout of corporate initiatives, tools, and new programs, ensuring cultural adaptation and consistent adoption across locations.


Operational Evaluations & Brand Standards

  • Perform standardized gym evaluations, operational audits, and brand assessments.
  • Ensure all LATAM locations remain compliant with system standards, brand guidelines, and operational policies.


Strategic Business & Financial Planning

  • Review and interpret financial reports (P&Ls, balance sheets, KPIs) to identify trends and coach franchisees on strategies for profitability and operational improvement.
  • Assist with strategic planning, forecasting, and staff planning tailored to the LATAM region.


Market Insights & System Collaboration

  • Conduct annual market reviews and monitor competitive activity in each territory.
  • Share benchmarking data, performance insights, and market intelligence with both franchisees and internal teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, technology, and development teams to align LATAM field strategies with broader corporate objectives.


Skills & Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish required.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in franchise operations, business consulting, or multi-unit fitness/hospitality management.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Exercise Science, or a related field preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead both in-person and virtual training programs in multiple languages.
  • Strong knowledge of fitness industry operations, financial drivers, and customer experience best practices.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and coaching skills, with a high degree of cultural intelligence.
  • Basic knowledge of gym technology platforms is a plus.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% or more across Latin America and Caribbean, including overnight travel and weekends when necessary.


Preferred Attributes

  • Passion for fitness, health, and wellness.
  • Experience supporting international franchise or multi-unit business models, particularly in Latin America.
  • Strong presence and confidence when leading groups and delivering training in culturally diverse environments.
  • High level of business acumen, adaptability, and emotional intelligence.
  • Familiarity with Gold’s Gym tools, systems, or service providers.

title: Cloud Native Developer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Senior Cloud Native Developer to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

  • Strong experience in software development with .NET Core and C# .
  • Strong knowledge of Azure cloud services , including Azure Functions , Service Bus , and Cosmos DB .
  • Experience with microservices architecture and event-driven systems .
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD concepts , including hands-on experience with GitHub Actions or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Pulumi , Terraform , or similar frameworks.
  • Experience building and managing containers (Docker) and working with container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes).
  • Strong understanding of software design principles , clean code , and best engineering practices .
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to work collaboratively in distributed, cross-functional teams.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):


  • Experience with Kafka or similar event streaming platforms.
  • Familiarity with Application Insights , Grafana , or other monitoring tools.

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

As the Principal Engineer for G&C, you will be the technical backbone of the department, reporting directly to the Department Manager. Your responsibilities include:

  • G&C Technical Leadership: Serving as the technical authority over the full G&C lifecycle, including Modeling & Simulation (MIL/SIL/PIL) , Guidance & Control Algorithms , Tracking Systems , and Estimation Filters (EKF/KF) .
  • R&D and Capability Establishment: Leading the investigation of emerging technologies and the implementation of futuristic methodologies. You will be responsible for establishing new G&C infrastructure, tools, and R&D labs .

  • Mentorship and Team Building: Providing technical guidance and mentoring to engineers across all levels (Junior to Senior), helping to cultivate a high-performing team.


Requirements for Success


  • Experience: 10–15 years of experience in the development of guided weapon systems , missiles, or relevant defense technologies.
  • Leadership: A minimum of 5 years of experience in engineering management and technical leadership roles, with a proven ability to lead teams and establish new capabilities.
  • Expertise: Deep knowledge of the entire Systems Engineering Process (qualification, acceptance, flight testing) and a strong background in flight dynamics, embedded systems, and missile control .
  • Qualifications: A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.


Ready for Your Next Career Move?


This is a Full-Time Employee (FTE) position requiring a professional who is willing to relocate to Abu Dhabi, UAE . A full relocation package is offered to ensure a smooth transition.


This role offers a clear career path toward Senior Principal Engineer and Chief Engineer , allowing you to directly shape the technological future of defense in the region.

If you are a result-driven technical leader ready to build and innovate in a high-stakes environment, we want to hear from you.


Apply now and help us establish next-generation guidance and control capabilities!

title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description:
About the Role


This is not a typical virtual assistant position. We're looking for an AI-forward Executive Assistant with a Chief-of-Staff potential in the future who builds systems, owns outcomes, and drives the week to zero open tabs and inbox zero.

You'll work directly with Billie Graham , a strategic leader managing multiple high-growth ventures across commercial construction, lead generation, nonprofit leadership, property management, and family. Billie is based in Charlotte, NC, and needs someone who can anticipate needs, convert ambiguity into calendar blocks and checklists, and relentlessly close loops.

The Goal: Expand capacity and increase velocity of execution through systems, AI automation, and proactive operational support.

This role offers rare exposure to diverse industries while building the foundational processes that will enable rapid scaling. You'll be part of the early team, collaboratively identifying tools and systems needed to achieve great outcomes.

About Billie's Ventures


All ventures are in growth mode, and most do not have formal processes yet. You'll solve for and document processes to allow rapid onboarding of future hires with repeatable results.

  • Myers & Chapman – Strategic Markets Leader for Healthcare and Public Projects at this Commercial General Contractor
  • Leads Exchange Group – Industry networking agency launching a new high-ticket service offering in 2025
  • ReGroup Carolinas – Board Member for this nonprofit focused on workforce development in construction trades
  • Rental Property – Management of two rental units


Who We're Looking For


We need a systems-thinker with high agency who is AI-native, proactive, and relentlessly follows through. You should be comfortable with ambiguity, able to convert loose ideas into structured action plans, and driven to improve workflows weekly.

Critical mindset: We're looking for critical thinking over "task-taker." You should anticipate needs, propose solutions, and own outcomes—not just execute orders.

Personality Traits of Successful Candidates:
  • Proactive and calm under pressure
  • Highly organized and goal-oriented
  • Systems-first thinker with high agency
  • Pushes for clarity and closes loops consistently
  • Low-ego, coachable, rigorous about details and data
  • Comfortable saying "no/next" to protect priorities
Operational Cadence & Responsibilities
Weekly Rhythm:

Calendar & Commitments:

  • Own and manage family/school/kids' activities, professional meetings, travel, and reservations
  • Send Friday Weekly Brief : next week at a glance, risks flagged, top 3 priorities identified

Inbox & Communications:

  • Triage emails and meeting invites daily
  • File receipts and manage reimbursements
  • Maintain stakeholder communication loops

Task System:

  • Maintain running capture board across all ventures
  • Convert texts/voice notes → tasks with deadlines
  • Confirm task owner and status; nudge until done

Research & Automation:

  • Conduct project research and generate executive summaries
  • Web scraping and competitive tracking
  • Automate report generation and research tasks
  • Contact enrichment and CRM logging
  • Public records, permits, budgets research

SOP Engine:

  • Record Looms of recurring tasks
  • Ship 1+ SOP per week to the vault
  • Document processes to enable future team scaling
  • Iterate and refine edge cases

Family/Personal Operations:

  • Manage school communications and kids' calendars
  • Coordinate family travel and summer camp planning
  • Handle household-related administrative tasks

AI & Systems Improvement:

  • Propose workflow automation improvements weekly
  • Implement AI tools to increase efficiency
  • Build and optimize capture → triage → plan → execute systems
  • Raise quality bars continuously
Required Skills & Experience
Must-Have:


  • 1–2 years minimum executive assistant or operations experience
  • Advanced AI literacy : Fluent with ChatGPT, Copilot, and Perplexity; strong prompt crafting abilities
  • Calendar triage & stakeholder management : Expert-level scheduling and communication coordination
  • Research skills : Public records, permits, budgets, market intelligence
  • SOP creation : Ability to document processes via Loom-to-SOP workflow
  • Excel/Power BI basics : Structured data work and simple reporting
  • Clear written English : Concise, action-oriented communication style
  • Security hygiene : Understanding of role-based access and data protection
  • Documentation discipline : Rigorous attention to detail
  • Strong interest in AI use cases and implementation
Nice-to-Have:


  • Basic Python or no-code automation experience (Zapier, Make, n8n)
  • AEC (Architecture/Engineering/Construction) familiarity: Procore, RFQ/RFP exposure
  • Web scraping capabilities
  • HubSpot or CRM management experience
  • Contact enrichment skills (LinkedIn, research tools)
  • Power BI visualization and dashboard creation
  • Golf handicap lookup experience (when relevant for relationship building)
Tools & Platforms You'll Use


  • Email/SMS (Google & Microsoft suites)
  • Ninety.io (project/goal management)
  • ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity (AI tools – critical)
  • Slack, Discord, Telegram (team communication)
  • SharePoint, Google Workspace, MS Teams (document management)
  • Excel (data organization)
  • Additional tools to be collaboratively identified
What We Offer


  • Compensation: Starting at $1,100 USD per month
  • Full-time position: 40 hours per week
  • Consistent schedule: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, Monday–Friday
  • Fully remote: Work from anywhere

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software Back-End - Sênior (Data Platform)
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Falando da área: Trabalhar na área de Engenharia da Neoway mantém o colaborador conectado com a inovação, ao constante aprimoramento por melhores metodologias de desenvolvimento e a novas tecnologias para atender os objetivos estratégicos e de negócios da Neoway.

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. O time de Engenharia é responsável por construir, evoluir e sustentar todo o ecossistema que compõem nossa plataforma de Big Data Analytics, chamada Plataforma Neoway.

Acreditamos que um software de qualidade é fácil de usar, funciona corretamente, é de fácil manutenção/sustentação, fácil integração e mantém a integridade para evitar possíveis falhas, fora ou não, do controle de quem o desenvolveu.

Para alcançar este objetivo atuamos em dois pilares distintos para garantir a eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software assegurando a qualidade junto a um ambiente saudável na área de Engenharia, no aspecto de boas práticas e cultura de desenvolvimento:

  • 1° - Pessoas é um pilar estratégico para Neoway, atuamos de maneira pró ativa em conjunto com todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento de talentos, crescimento profissional e formação do nosso DNA, impulsionando a cultura de times de alta performance (liberdade com responsabilidade).
  • 2° - Técnico (Paved Way), acreditamos que ferramental e a automação ajudam a dimensionar a capacidade de um time, mas nenhuma ferramenta resolverá todos os problemas na produtividade no desenvolvimento ou nas operações. A ideia é ter um conjunto de ferramentas e práticas de “paved way” que são formalmente suportadas por algumas pessoas. Não exigimos a adoção desses “paved way” , mas incentivamos a adoção, garantindo que o desenvolvimento e as operações usando essas tecnologias sejam uma experiência muito melhor do que não usá-las.

Falando do time: O foco do time de Data Platform é impulsionar a estratégia de Plataforma de Dados e Big Data na Neoway, fornecendo ferramentas, estabelecendo padrões e oferecendo suporte para que os times de dados possam acelerar o desenvolvimento de produtos, aumentando a celeridade e a autonomia desses times.

#Missão do cargo

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software no time de Data Platform, você será responsável por criar ferramentas e soluções para as pessoas engenheiras de dados da empresa, atuando desde a concepção até o lançamento em produção de soluções de coleta e integração de dados. Seu objetivo será simplificar e abstrair a plataforma, tornando-a mais eficiente e fácil de usar. Suas responsabilidades incluirão evoluir nosso motor de ingestão de dados, desenvolver protótipos para provas de conceito, manter nossa plataforma de dados na cloud (GCP) e realizar o troubleshooting da plataforma com métricas customizadas. Em um ambiente inovador e colaborativo, você agregará conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo e construindo soluções para nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, qualidade do código e arquitetura, visando um trabalho harmônico em equipe.


Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas através da participação ativa em Code Reviews e do desenvolvimento de testes unitários e de integração;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos;
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar a Plataforma de Dados da Neoway;
  • Propor e criar ferramentas e pipelines de dados eficientes;
  • Manter e otimizar a plataforma de dados para ingestão, coleta e distribuição dos dados;
  • Fomentar e evoluir a cultura de engenharia de software no time;
  • Oferecer suporte e consultoria aos engenheiros de dados da plataforma;
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e Python;
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços;
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões de alta performance;
  • Demonstrar prudência e cuidado no gerenciamento de grandes volumes de dados;


Para assumir estas responsabilidades você precisa ter as seguintes habilidades:

  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros.
  • Conhecer sobre processo de desenvolvimento de software, da concepção à entrega e subsequente monitoramento;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento com seus pares;
  • Promover o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe;
  • Ter experienciado práticas com Code Review e Feedback;
  • Conhecimento avançado em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação;
  • Conhecimento de desenvolvimento na linguagem Golang;
  • Experiência na construção de APIs REST;
  • Experiência em execução de sistemas baseados em containers (Docker);
  • Experiência nos processos de versionamento de código (Git) e práticas de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com banco de dados relacionais e/ou não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB);
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura e Cloud, de preferência GCP;
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre Big Data, como por exemplo Datalake, catálogo de esquemas e metadados;


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Ter sido responsável por um projeto de ponta a ponta, incluindo desenvolvimento, deploy e monitoramento;
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de sistemas baseados em arquitetura de microsserviços;
  • Experiência com Infra as a Code (Terraform e Ansible);
  • Experiência com Kafka;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes;
  • Experiência com processamento distribuído (e.g., Spark);
  • Expertise com governança de dados: qualidade, linhagem de dados e segurança;
  • Conhecimento avançado sobre Big Data e Plataformas de dados;
  • Experiência com processamento de dados em batch com Apache Beam

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Country Manager – LATAM to lead and scale our operations across the region. This role is 80% operations-focused, with responsibility for resource management, workforce planning, employee engagement, HR, HR compliance, and strategic growth. The remaining 20% requires technical acumen to manage tech people, understand how tech operations are run, and participate in technical discussions with clients.

The right candidate will have proven experience in managing, scaling, and setting up IT/Tech teams, ensuring smooth delivery and operational excellence. They must be adept at building and inspiring high-performing teams, driving compliance and retention, and cultivating trusted long-term relationships with clients and stakeholders.


What’s Exciting About This Role?

  • Lead and shape our entire LATAM operation, with the autonomy to make high-impact decisions.
  • Build and inspire a high-performing, multicultural team while forging strong client relationships.
  • Play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence and market presence.
  • Work in a fast-paced, global environment where your ideas are implemented, not just discussed.



Key Responsibilities


, HR & Resource Management

  • Oversee all LATAM resources to ensure productivity and quality.
  • Manage the full employee lifecycle including hiring, onboarding, HR compliance, and performance management.
  • Monitor attrition rates and implement proactive retention strategies.
  • Drive employee satisfaction through engagement programs, career development, and structured feedback channels.


Tech Operations Oversight

  • Manage and scale tech operations and delivery teams .
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Provide credible oversight in technical discussions with clients.
  • Stakeholder & Customer Engagement
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and customers across LATAM.
  • Act as the primary liaison for client needs, service delivery, and customer success.
  • Represent the company at local and regional events, forums, and client meetings.


Operational Leadership & Strategic Growth

  • Lead daily operations, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and alignment with corporate policies.
  • Collaborate with HR, Finance, and global teams for seamless cross-functional workflows.
  • Monitor performance metrics and provide regular updates to regional/global leadership.
  • Adapt and execute market-specific strategies aligned with global objectives.


Financial & Market Insight Contribution

  • Support budget planning, resource allocation, and cost optimization.
  • Provide local market intelligence to inform global strategic decisions.



Key Qualifications & Skills

Analisar, planejar e executar desenvolvimento e/ou manutenção de soluções de GIS/TI nas fases de Design, Construção, Tecnologia, Requisitos, Teste, Infraestrutura, Configuração e Qualidade.


Formação:

  • Graduado.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Experiência trabalhando com serviços restfull e microserviços;
  • Conhecimentos em html5, CSS3, node.js, angular, vue e react;
  • Conhecimentos em Python;
  • Conhecimentos em SQL e Análise de Dados;
  • Experiência em levantar e documentar requisitos juntos aos usuários;
  • Capacidade de realizar testes unitários e de integração;
  • Capacidade de desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando todas as linguagens suportadas na plataforma ArcGIS.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Certificações;
  • Especializações/Mestrado;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimentos na plataforma ArcGIS;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios.


Responsabilidades:

  • Escrever códigos de desenvolvimento dos sistemas seguindo padrões de nomenclatura e práticas da empresa;
  • Detalhar projetos, determinando suas interfaces, limites de automação e plataforma tecnológica;
  • Construir modelos funcionais e de dados de sistemas, aplicando boas práticas que garantam visão estruturada, qualidade, reutilização, facilidade de manutenção de códigos;
  • Identificar, avaliar e definir frameworks, componentes e softwares para desenvolvimento, através da conceituação, documentação e experimentação, buscando aprimorar as soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Realizar avaliações de segurança e performance de soluções;
  • Aplicar e avaliar testes funcionais e não funcionais, seguindo o plano de testes estabelecido, junto ao cliente visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Escrever o plano de testes funcionais e não funcionais visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Avaliar e elaborar a documentação de usuário e administração de sistemas desenvolvidos e os repositórios de informação dos projetos;
  • Assegurar as interfaces de integração com outras plataformas/soluções.


Por que escolher a Geosistemas?

Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.
  • ️ ♂️ Acesso ao Gympass para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

title: College-Level Chemistry Tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.


Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.


Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.


We need tutors who can start immediately!

title: Especialista em Parcerias Estratégicas
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de um Especialista em Parcerias para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Identificar, mapear e prospectar organizações estratégicas (empresas de grande porte, associações e sindicatos).
  • Estruturar e negociar parcerias comerciais com potencial de gerar grande volume de usuários ou receita recorrente.
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com BPOs que atendem empresas de grande porte para viabilizar contratos de alto impacto.
  • Representar a Jusfy em eventos estratégicos do setor jurídico, contábil e corporativo.
  • Acompanhar performance das parcerias e propor planos de expansão.


Experiência

  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de parcerias estratégicas, negócios corporativos ou vendas complexas (preferencialmente em SaaS ou tecnologia).
  • Vivência em ambiente de crescimento e ritmo acelerado.
  • Disponibilidade para visitas presenciais a clientes/parceiros.


Diferencial

  • Experiência ou conhecimentos sobre o mercado jurídico.


Habilidades

  • Capacidade de negociação em alto nível e construção de relacionamentos de longo prazo.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultados.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de representação em eventos externos.


Ferramentas e dados

  • Experiência com CRM (preferencialmente Hubspot)


Perfil comportamental

  • Proatividade, ownership e foco em solução de problemas
  • Curiosidade e sede por aprendizado contínuo
  • Mentalidade orientada a resultados e crescimento


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Partnership Specialist e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se aplique na vaga.

title: Brazil -Front-end Developer
description:
In Short

Arke is actively searching for a qualified Front-end developer in Brazil. You'll join our dynamic team, collaborating directly with our Brazil Country Head and fellow developers to create intuitive, appealing, and performant web applications for our clients. We’re looking for someone passionate about crafting outstanding user experiences and eager to stay current with evolving digital technologies.


Code samples are required.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Collaborate with team members and clients to design and implement high-quality solutions based on technical and business requirements.
  • Use modern development standards and tools to create software applications that delight users.
  • Produce detailed documentation, test plans, and maintain well-documented, clean, and efficient code.
  • Foster trusted partnerships with coworkers and clients.
  • Develop interactive prototypes to explore innovative UI solutions.
  • Develop tested and documented TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Build responsive and cross-browser compatible applications optimized for desktop and mobile.
  • Adhere strictly to branding guidelines and UX standards.
  • Maintain positive and productive working relationships with stakeholders, peers, and management.


What We’d Love to See

  • 2–4 years of professional front-end development experience.
  • Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and TypeScript.
  • Proven professional experience using React.
  • Familiarity with Git workflows and branch strategies.
  • Experience with browser compatibility testing and debugging
  • Strong understanding of UI design principles and layout aesthetics.
  • Basic knowledge of SEO best practices.
  • Intermediate spoken English, fluent in written English.


Soft Skills

  • Ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.
  • Have excellent analytical and multitasking skills.
  • Be reliable and dependable, consistently meeting deadlines and commitments.


Nice to have

  • Experience with Next.js.
  • Familiarity with additional front-end frameworks.
  • Experience with content management systems (CMS).
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or related fields.


Who We Are

Arke is a full-service experience design and technology consultancy that believes in providing more – much more. We change the way brands approach digital transformation and create defining moments to better connect brands with their customers. Arke’s core values are the soul of who we are and shape everything we do. We are authentically unique, operate with high standards, and love what we do.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais, somos GPTW.


Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys! Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


Perfil Profissional – Desenvolvedor Java | Pleno

Desenvolvedor Java com sólida experiência em sistemas distribuídos e arquitetura de microsserviços, especializado em autenticação, autorização e protocolos de segurança como OAuth2, OpenID Connect e JWT. Atua com foco no desenvolvimento de mecanismos de Single Sign-On (SSO) para ambientes corporativos, garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e conformidade com padrões modernos de identidade digital.

Com domínio em Spring Security, Spring Authorization Server, Keycloak, Azure AD, Auth0 e outras soluções de identidade, projeta fluxos de autenticação robustos e integrações seguras entre múltiplos sistemas internos e externos. Possui expertise na implementação de Identity Providers (IdP), Resource Servers e Authorization Servers, bem como na configuração de clients OAuth2 com grant types como Authorization Code, Client Credentials, e Refresh Tokens.

Também é responsável por definir estratégias de controle de acesso baseado em roles (RBAC) e atributos (ABAC), configuração de políticas de autorização, integração com diretórios corporativos (LDAP, AD), e hardening de endpoints REST com escopos e claims personalizados.

Competências Técnicas

Linguagem: Java 8–21

Frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Authorization Server, Apache Camel

SSO & Identity: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, SAML 2.0, Keycloak, Auth0, Azure Active Directory, Okta

Segurança: Criptografia, JWK/JWS, HTTPS/TLS, CORS, CSRF, PKCE

Integrações: LDAP, Active Directory, SCIM

Testes: Testcontainers, JUnit, Mockito, integração com testes de segurança

DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD com Jenkins, GitLab ou GitHub Actions

Diferenciais

Experiência na migração de sistemas legados para arquiteturas modernas com SSO.

Atuação direta no desenho e implementação de Identity Providers e Authorization Servers próprios.

Capacidade de liderar times na definição de padrões de autenticação e segurança em ambientes corporativos.

Vivência com compliance de segurança, como LGPD e GDPR, aplicando princípios de privacy-by-design.

Diferencial: com conhecimento em Autenticação, Autorização e SSO com OAuth2Habilidades:


Hardskills:


- Java

- Spring Boot

- Spring Security

- Spring Authorization Server

- OAuth2

- OpenID Connect

- JWT

- Keycloak

- Azure Active Directory

- Docker

- Kubernetes


Softskills:


- Autonomia, Proatividade e Iniciativa

- Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe


Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Remoto


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!


Assistência médica;

VR e VA flexível;

Gympass e Wellz;

Parceria com o SESC;

Descontos em restaurantes;

Descontos em cursos técnicos e de ensinos superior;

Descontos em escolas e plataformas de idiomas.


E aí, aceita o desafio? Então conclua sua candidatura e #VemSerFoursys! Boa sorte!
